title: Kothari Education Commission
definition: The Indian Education Commission (1964–1966), popularly known as the Kothari Commission, was a national commission appointed by the Government of India to formulate a comprehensive, national pattern of education and advise on the national policy of education principles for development at all levels.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (historical chronology, committee chairpersons, key quantitative targets like 6% GDP) and Mains GS Paper 1 & 2 (evolution of Indian education policy, post-independence institution building, and structural reforms).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Kothari Education Commission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
